lines.text: Ish-bosheth loses courage when he hears Abner has died in Hebron, and Baanah and Rechab, raiding leaders, are from Benjamin.
Jonathan's five-year-old son falls and becomes lame as his nurse flees, and his name is Mephibosheth.
Rechab and Baanah enter the house as if to get wheat, stab Ish-bosheth in the stomach, and behead him.
The brothers bring the head to David at Gath, and David recalls killing the messenger who reported Saul's death at Ziklag.
David's young men kill Rechab and Baanah, hang their bodies by the pool, and bury Ish-bosheth's head in Saul's tomb.
